# Merge Request

**Title:** [MERGE] Brief description of the merge

**Description of changes**  
Provide a clear and detailed description of what changes are being introduced in this pull request. Be sure to mention if the change introduces new features, bug fixes, or enhancements.

**Related issues**  
Link any related issues using keywords like `Fixes #123`, `Closes #456`, etc.  
Example: Fixes #123

**Type of change**  
Mark the relevant options with an `x`:
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Documentation update (if applicable)

**Testing Instructions**  
Provide steps to test the changes locally, including any setup or dependencies that need to be handled.  
1. Step one  
2. Step two  
3. ...

**Screenshots (if applicable)**  
Attach screenshots or GIFs if your changes include UI updates.

**Checklist**  
Before submitting the merge request, ensure the following tasks are complete:
- [ ] My code follows the code style of this project.
- [ ] I have added tests to cover my changes.
- [ ] All new and existing tests pass.
- [ ] Documentation has been updated accordingly (if applicable).

**Additional context**  
Provide any additional context or information that might be helpful for the reviewers.
